data.text:
Jacob Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 June, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.5855/2021 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Friday, the 21st day of June 2024 / 31st Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2021 In Crl.Mc No. 5855 Of 2021
 Cc 1130/2021 Of Judicial First Class, Magistrate Court Thiruvalla,
 Pathanamthitta
 Applicants/Petitioners/Petitioners/Accused Nos 4 to 7:
 1. Jacob Thomas, Aged 50 Years, Plantharayil, Alappuzha-689121
 (Nominee Of The Marketing Of The Unsafe Food Article).
 And 3 Others.
 Respondents/Complainant,State & Another:
 1. The Food Safety Officer Thiruvalla Circle, 4Th Floor, Revenue
 Tower, Thiruvalla-689101.
 And 2 Others... 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High  Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C.1130/2021  pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate,
 Thiruvalla, pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 23/05/2024 in Crl.M.A.1/2021  and upon hearing the arguments of Mr. PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocate for  petitioners and the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for R1 and R2 and of Mr. SANTHAN  V NAIR, STANDING COUNSEL for R3, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Jacob Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173409549/
1 Interim order is extended by six months. 
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 21-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Jacob Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173409549/ 
2
